title: Retaining Wall quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install a new two-tier concrete sleeper retaining wall, sixteen linear metres long, replacing an existing timber wall. The wall will be constructed using thirty-two concrete sleepers (two thousand millimetres long, two hundred millimetres high, eighty millimetres thick) stacked two high. Nine galvanised steel H-beam posts (one hundred Universal Column, fourteen kilograms per metre) will be set into concrete footings measuring three hundred by three hundred by six hundred millimetres deep. Includes supply and installation of sixteen linear metres of ninety-millimetre slotted ag pipe, half a cubic metre of twenty-millimetre drainage gravel, ten square metres of geotextile fabric behind the wall, and four cubic metres of clean backfill material.
workingDetail: Retaining wall blocks or sleepers, Steel posts (galvanised H-beams), Concrete footings, Drainage gravel and ag pipe
